text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's time for a most thrilling cooking
experience!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Woo, woooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...This concerns me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started! On the table, you'll
find your
single ingredient—a cup of
premade instant
ramen noodles!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, and just by adding a drop of
this special
flavoring I've concocted...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Something wonderful will happen! These
already
delicious noodles will become
even better!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's something really... fishy about
this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Lies! This is the precious end product of
my
inquisitive foray into the culinary
world! I
certainly don't have any
intentions to record the
effects you
experience upon tasting this novel

deliciousness!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured! We've already tried this
taste
explosion for ourselves, so it's
perfectly safe to
eat! Go on, have a bite!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There she goes. No talking her down
when she
gets like this.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We don't have much of a choice... The
two of
them seem unharmed... so let's
give their noodles
a try.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So, what are your thoughts? The added
flavoring
really makes the difference,
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm shocked. It's actually way better.
What's that
flavoring made of?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I guess some things... aren't always
certain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
See? This is a show of my vested interest
in the
culinary arts. There's nothing
better than a
delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's not all. This flavoring also
enhances the
after-meal tea—urk?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This tea tastes like ramen. I must not
have
accounted for the duration of the
flavoring's
effect on the tastebuds...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wait, does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Tachyon, you've got to let me try
some!
Does it taste like soy sauce
ramen? Pork bone
broth? Oh, is it miso?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I knew this would be terrible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the rest of the day, all the food they
eat
tastes like ramen. Only Fine Motion
remains
enthusiastic about the ordeal.
